The cell did complete a short daytime pilot without any interruption, which is encouraging. Before I authorize the overnight run, I need to hear from each of you on readiness. Let's go through it function by function -- training supervision, quality engineering, and electrical maintenance. What relevant readiness items do you each have for this new-cell run?

My roster check found that only one of tonight's three scheduled operators holds the current automated-cell certification. Plant policy requires two certified operators on the cell. I did confirm in the training system this afternoon that a certified day-shift operator is available to cover the second position, so we can meet the requirement. I want to flag this so we can either wait for the sync or manually document the coverage change before the run proceeds.
